purpose: define a separate candidate route for uncertainty over a predeclared outer training-source resampling process, with inner training refits nested inside each source draw and validation blocks crossed with the source axis

relationship_to_v5.current_v5_estimand: E_r_given_S E_v D conditional on one frozen empirical training source S
relationship_to_v5.candidate_v0_estimand: E_s E_r_given_s E_v D over one predeclared outer source-resampling process, its nested inner training-resampling process, and the declared validation population

dependence_structure.outer_source_draws: exchangeable draws from one frozen source-resampling process
dependence_structure.validation_blocks: crossed with outer source draws and shared across all inner refits

candidate_reduction.cell_definition: for each outer source draw s, validation block b, group g and contrast c, average the weighted gain over the fixed number of inner refits nested within s
candidate_reduction.outer_source_draw_weighting: equal weight per outer source draw regardless of inner refit count
candidate_reduction.validation_block_weighting: declared validation sample weights retained inside block ratio
candidate_reduction.effective_training_side_cluster_count: number of outer source draws S, not S times R
candidate_reduction.candidate_variance: two-term CV3(2) delete-one jackknife over outer source draw and validation block after inner-refit aggregation
candidate_reduction.candidate_compound_test: intersection-union test over every required group x ordered information contrast
